Greenhouse climate control

Temperature, humidity and CO₂ are held automatically from sensor data, the owner checks on the phone, and harvests are steadier. An MVP in 6–10 weeks, from UZS 96 mln; the full version in 14–22 weeks.

Questions

What does “Greenhouse climate control” cost?
The MVP costs $8,000–16,000 (UZS 96–193 mln), the full version $20,000–45,000 (UZS 240–545 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Greenhouse climate control” take?
The MVP takes 6–10 weeks, the full version 14–22 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
Site access and space for the devices; internet or SIM cards; a budget for the hardware, which is not in the price.
